malaysia_movies.title: Practical Magic
malaysia_movies.description: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

malaysia_movies.title: The Whisper Man
malaysia_movies.description: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

malaysia_movies.title: Vishwanath & Sons
malaysia_movies.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

malaysia_movies.title: Remember Me
malaysia_movies.description: Still reeling from a heartbreaking family event and his parents' subsequent divorce, Tyler Hawkins discovers a fresh lease on life when he meets Ally Craig, a gregarious beauty who witnessed her mother's death. But as the couple draws closer, the fallout from their separate tragedies jeopardizes their love.

malaysia_movies.title: The Legend of Tarzan
malaysia_movies.description: Tarzan, having acclimated to life in London, is called back to his former home in the jungle to investigate the activities at a mining encampment.

malaysia_movies.title: The Gentlemen
malaysia_movies.description: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

malaysia_movies.title: I Swear
malaysia_movies.description: Diagnosed with Tourette Syndrome at 15, John Davidson navigates his way against the odds through troubled teenage years and into adulthood, finding inspiration in the kindness of others to discover his true purpose in life.

malaysia_movies.title: STRAW
malaysia_movies.description: What will be her last straw? A devastatingly bad day pushes a hardworking single mother to the breaking point — and into a shocking act of desperation.

malaysia_movies.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
malaysia_movies.description: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

malaysia_movies.title: The Terminator
malaysia_movies.description: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

malaysia_tv.title: The Gentlemen
malaysia_tv.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

malaysia_tv.title: The Perfect Lie
malaysia_tv.description: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

malaysia_tv.title: Crew Girl
malaysia_tv.description: 16-year-old rower Teagan becomes coxswain of a troubled boys' crew at an elite prep school. She navigates team drama, romance, rival crews, and a complex relationship with her mom while trying to lead them to victory.

malaysia_tv.title: Fauda
malaysia_tv.description: A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian militant he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.

malaysia_tv.title: Solo Leveling
malaysia_tv.description: Follows the adventures of Sung Jinwoo in a world that is constantly threatened by monsters and evil forces. In his battles Sung transforms himself from the weakest hunter of all mankind to one of the strongest hunters in existence.

malaysia_tv.title: Stolen Heartbeats
malaysia_tv.description: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

malaysia_tv.title: The Mentalist
malaysia_tv.description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

malaysia_tv.title: The Rookie
malaysia_tv.description: Starting over isn't easy, especially for John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of joining the LAPD. As their oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from those who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

malaysia_tv.title: Graveyard
malaysia_tv.description: Police Commissioner Önem leads a special investigations unit that solves tough cases involving violence against women.

malaysia_tv.title: Rick and Morty
malaysia_tv.description: The fractured domestic lives of a nihilistic mad scientist and his anxious grandson are further complicated by their inter-dimensional misadventures.
